lemma ticket (hC: choir q)(hd:2*d≤ FullVolume.Amp.glint) (h':mild Ω x.1)(hv:‖x.2‖≤ 1/8)(y:ℝ×Home T)(hs:mild Ω y.1)(hu:‖y.2‖≤1/8) : ‖reading H hp y-reading H hp x‖ ≤ 8*FullVolume.Amp.glint*‖y-x‖ ∧ ‖drum H y-drum H x‖≤8*fn A.B.a m v*‖y-x‖:=by
   have hx := termsN g H h hq hp ht hC h' (show ‖x.2‖≤1 by linarith); have hy:= termsN g H h hq hp ht hC hs (show ‖y.2‖≤1 by linarith); have hx':0≤ fn A.B.a m v:=(norm_nonneg _).trans hx.2
   by_cases hb:‖y-x‖≤1/4
   · obtain ⟨⟨P,hP⟩,⟨Q,hQ⟩⟩:= incomeP g H h hq hp ht hC hd h' hv
     refine ⟨?_, (hQ.wave hb (zipped T).1).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hx']) (norm_nonneg _))⟩
     change ‖World.ready (Pass.reading H hp y)-World.ready (Pass.reading H hp x)‖≤ _
     exact (hP.wave hb (zipped T).1).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num [FullVolume.Amp.glint]) (norm_nonneg _))
   push Not at hb; constructor
   · apply (norm_sub_le (Pass.reading H hp y) _).trans; nlinarith [FullVolume.Amp.tintP.1,hx.1,hy.1]
   apply (norm_sub_le (drum H y) _).trans; nlinarith [hx.2,hy.2]

proof_context.conclusion: `ticket` bounds the difference of the activity-coordinate map by `8*glint*‖y-x‖` and of the scalar correction by `8*fn*‖y-x‖`, by subtracting the series when `‖y-x‖ ≤ 1/4` and otherwise by the separate norm bounds `termsN` of the two arguments.

lemma tickets (h:m<N): let y:=max (dist (U (m+1)) (V (m+1))) (dist (gifts T (m+1)) (gifts W (m+1))); dist (gifts T m) (gifts W m) ≤8*glint*y ∧‖price T m-price W m‖≤4*stow A.B.a w m*y:=by
    dsimp only; rw [lifts _ h.le,lifts _ h.le, prime _ h,prime _ h,lifts (m+1) h,lifts (m+1) h,hT.route m h h, hw.route m h h,stow,show (4:ℝ)*(2*fn A.B.a m w)= 8*fn A.B.a m w from (by ring)]
    exact curls Y O (h:=h) (U (m+1),T.liftP _ h) (hT.moods _ h) (T.valid ..) (V (m+1),W.liftP _ h) (hw.moods _ h) (W.valid ..)
omit hT hw

proof_context.conclusion: `tickets` states the two history bounds `dist (gifts T m) (gifts W m) ≤ 8*glint*y` and `‖price T m - price W m‖ ≤ 4*stow*y`, with `y` the maximum of the next-level distances.

lemma bootD (hb:q/2 ≤ grand Ω)(hd: 2*(4*t') ≤ FullVolume.Amp.glint){x y:ℝ}(hv:mild Ω x)(hx:mild Ω y): ‖World.ready (Yawn ht y)-World.ready (Yawn ht x)‖ ≤ 8*FullVolume.Amp.glint*‖y-x‖:=by
   obtain ⟨P,hP⟩:= bootP R ht hr hu hC hY hb hd hv -- field order
   by_cases hp:‖y-x‖≤1/4
   · exact (hP.wave hp isometry_id).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num [FullVolume.Amp.glint]) (norm_nonneg _))
   apply (norm_sub_le ..).trans; push Not at hp; have hh:= bootN R ht hr hu hC hY hb hv; have h:= bootN R ht hr hu hC hY hb hx; nlinarith [FullVolume.Amp.tintP.1]

proof_context.conclusion: `bootD` gives the Wilson top map the same bound `8*glint*‖y-x‖`, with the same case split at distance 1/4.
